textRuns.value: KPI definitions: Funnel sessions = sessions with at least one event of that step; order within a session is not checked. Step drop-off = 1 minus (sessions at the step divided by sessions at the previous step); blank for view_item. Limitations: not a strict sequence, so drop-off is indicative. Totals cover only the funnel window above. Sample data from a different organisation; not CMRD users.
